'''Geileg''' was the company that manufactured the [[20m-cp Strobe/C-Beam Lamp/Legends|20m-cp Strobe/C-Beam Lamps]] that were installed aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="SWS" />
